en: A black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographic views. The upper image shows a large historic church with a steep roof and small tower standing on a hill, surrounded by trees and adjacent to a multi‑storey house; the caption "Burkhardswalde" is printed in the sky area. The lower image is an elevated view over a rural village with farm buildings, fields, and a river or canal in the foreground, stretching into open countryside.
